evidence_quotes.quote: AGUA, JUSTICIA Y MIGRACIÓN EN MÉXICO: UNA REFLEXIÓN DESDE EL DERECHO HUMANO AL AGUA
This article aims to examine how environmental migration in Mexico is linked to water scarcity, the human right to water with international agreements and treaties to which Mexico is a party.
